criteria.text: Two test tenants share a cluster and cannot see or reach each other's machines, networks or data
criteria.how: Create two tenants and try every way across from each

criteria.text: A tenant uses an address range that overlaps another tenant's, and both work
criteria.how: Give two test tenants the same range and run traffic in both

criteria.text: A tenant creates machines and networks alone and is stopped at its quota
criteria.how: Let a test tenant provision until the quota is reached

criteria.text: A new tenant is onboarded by workflow or API in under an hour
criteria.how: Run the onboarding for a test tenant and time it

criteria.text: A month of a tenant's usage reaches the billing system without manual steps
criteria.how: Export a test tenant's usage and load it into billing

criteria.text: A tenant's machine moves in from another platform within its window, keeping its addresses
criteria.how: Migrate a test tenant's machine and time the cutover

readiness: A cluster or region set aside for the test
Two test tenants, with an administrator each
The billing system's import format, or a sample invoice
Address ranges for the test tenants, overlapping on purpose
A machine on the old platform that may be migrated
The tenants' identity source to connect: a directory or single sign-on
